page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem features a 35 MB shared L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and 32 KB L1 data cache. The instance includes 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction capabilities include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, BMI2, and FMA, enabling optimized vectorized execution.

The instance operates without local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for all persistent filesystems and operating system disks. Network connectivity is provisioned with a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Acceleration hardware such as discrete GPUs is absent. The lack of onboard NVMe storage shifts I/O dependencies entirely to network-attached block storage, while the 1:2 memory configuration targets computational throughput over in-memory dataset capacity.

Synthetic and system benchmarks position the instance within the average tier for multi-threaded performance. Stress-ng multi-core testing reached 27991.83, while single-core execution scored 1312.99, indicating lower single-thread efficiency relative to modern alternatives. The system demonstrated 19.2 GB/sec static web serving throughput and 26.78 million operations per second in Redis SET operations, alongside solid clang compilation results in Geekbench. With its balanced parallel processing density and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.c6e.8xlarge serves multi-threaded batch processing, distributed continuous integration builds, microservices, and general compute workloads effectively.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server designed for compute-heavy parallel workloads. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, supported by 35 MB of L3 cache. It features 64 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB of memory per core. The server includes no local disk storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistence, and features no hardware GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is rated at a 10 Gbps baseline. Instruction extensions include AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES cryptographic acceleration. Benchmark results show average multi-core processing throughput, static web serving at 19.2 GB/sec, and steady Redis performance at 26.78 million operations per second, though single-core compression benchmarks indicate modest per-thread throughput. This profile suits multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, distributed web serving, and database tasks.
